title: PUCN Order — Docket 26-04019 (2026-07-08)
text:
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF NEVADA 
Annual Report of Shell Energy North America (US), 
L.P. on compliance with the Portfolio Standard for 
Renewable Energy for Compliance Year 2025. 
___________________________________________

Docket No. 26-04019 
At a general session of the Public Utilities 
Commission of Nevada, held at its offices 
on June 30, 2026. 
PRESENT: 
Chair Hayley Williamson 
Commissioner Tammy Cordova 
Commissioner Randy J. Brown 
Assistant Commission Secretary Trisha Osborne 
ORDER 
The Public Utilities Commission of Nevada (“Commission”) makes the following 
findings of fact and conclusions of law: 
I.
INTRODUCTION 
On April 15, 2026, Shell Energy North America (US), L.P. (“Shell Energy”) filed with 
the Commission an annual report, designated as Docket No. 26-04019, on compliance with the 
renewable energy portfolio standard (“RPS”) for compliance year 2025. 
II.
SUMMARY 
The Commission approves the annual report and finds that Shell Energy has complied 
with the RPS requirements for 2025. 
III.
PROCEDURAL HISTORY 
• On April 15, 2026, Shell Energy filed the annual report pursuant to the Nevada Revised 
Statutes (“NRS”) and the Nevada Administrative Code (“NAC”) Chapters 703 and 704, 
including, but not limited to, NRS 704.7825, NAC 704.8877, and NAC 704.8879; additionally, 
Shell Energy requests confidential treatment of certain information contained in its Annual 
Report pursuant to NRS 703.190 and NAC 703.527 et seq. 
• On April 20, 2026, the Commission issued a Notice of Electric Provider’s Annual Report on 
Compliance with the Nevada Renewable Energy Portfolio Standard. 
• The Regulatory Operations Staff of the Commission (“Staff”) participates as a matter of right 
pursuant to NRS 703.301. 

Docket No. 26-04019 
Page 2 
• On June 25, 2026, Staff filed a briefing memorandum (“Staff Briefing Memo”). 
IV.
ANNUAL REPORT 
Shell Energy’s Position
1.
Shell Energy states that it had no sales of energy in Nevada in compliance year 
2025, and consequently, no RPS obligation; therefore, Shell Energy provides that it has retired 
sufficient portfolio energy credits (“PECs”) to meet its requirements for 2025. (Annual Report at 
1-2.). 
Staff’s Position 
2.
Staff states that Shell Energy had zero retail electricity sales in Nevada during 
compliance year 2025 and thus had zero RPS procurement requirement for compliance year 
2025. (Staff Briefing Memo at 1.) 
3.
Staff states that effective December 31, 2024, the contract under which Shell 
Energy supplied electric power to its only Nevada based customer, Nevada Gold Mines LLC 
(“NGM”), was terminated. Consequently, Shell Energy did not sell electricity to retail customers 
in the State of Nevada during compliance year 2025. (Id.) 
4.
Staff states that the information submitted by Shell Energy demonstrates that it 
complies with the requirements of the RPS for compliance year 2025, and Staff has verified that 
the Annual Report contains the reporting information required by NAС 704.8879(2). (Id. at 2) 
Commission Discussion and Findings 
5.
The Commission finds that it is in the public interest to accept Staff’s 
recommendations: to find that Shell Energy has met its required compliance with the RPS for 
compliance year 2025 as Shell Energy had no sales in Nevada in 2025, and therefore, no RPS 
requirement in Nevada for compliance year 2025.

Docket No. 26-04019 
Page 3 
THEREFORE, it is ORDERED: 
1.
The Annual Report filed by Shell Energy North America (US), L.P., designated as 
Docket No. 26-04019, is approved. 
2.
Shell Energy North America (US), L.P. has complied with the renewable portfolio 
standard for compliance year 2025.
